{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Cairo workflow
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types:
      - checks_requested

env:
  STABLE_VERSION: "1.94.0"

jobs:
  scarb-fmt:
    runs-on: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-medium-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./stwo_cairo_verifier
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: software-mansion/setup-scarb@v1
      - name: Cache Scarb dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/scarb
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-scarb-${{ hashFiles('stwo_cairo_verifier/Scarb.lock') }}
      - run: scarb fmt --check

  scarb-lint:
    runs-on: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-medium-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./stwo_cairo_verifier
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: software-mansion/setup-scarb@v1
      - name: Cache Scarb dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/scarb
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-scarb-${{ hashFiles('stwo_cairo_verifier/Scarb.lock') }}
      - run: scarb lint --features=qm31_opcode --deny-warnings

  scarb-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./stwo_cairo_verifier
    strategy:
      matrix:
        feature: [poseidon252_verifier, "poseidon252_verifier,poseidon_outputs_packing", qm31_opcode, "qm31_opcode,blake_outputs_packing", "qm31_opcode,poseidon_outputs_packing"]
        package:
          - stwo_verifier_core
          - stwo_cairo_air
          - stwo_cairo_verifier
          - stwo_verifier_utils
        include:
          # ==========================================
          # Proof Files Mapping
          # ==========================================
          - feature: poseidon252_verifier
            proof_file: ../test_data/test_prove_verify_ret_opcode/proof.json
          - feature: "poseidon252_verifier,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            proof_file: ../test_data/test_prove_verify_ret_opcode/proof.json
          - feature: qm31_opcode
            proof_file: ../test_data/test_prove_verify_all_opcode_components/proof.json
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,blake_outputs_packing"
            proof_file: ../test_data/test_prove_verify_all_opcode_components/proof.json
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            proof_file: ../test_data/test_prove_verify_all_opcode_components/proof.json
          # ==========================================
          # Explicit Runner Size Mapping (20 combinations)
          # ==========================================
          # 1. stwo_verifier_utils (All small)
          - feature: poseidon252_verifier
            package: stwo_verifier_utils
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "poseidon252_verifier,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_verifier_utils
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: qm31_opcode
            package: stwo_verifier_utils
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,blake_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_verifier_utils
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_verifier_utils
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          # 2. stwo_verifier_core (All small)
          - feature: poseidon252_verifier
            package: stwo_verifier_core
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "poseidon252_verifier,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_verifier_core
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: qm31_opcode
            package: stwo_verifier_core
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,blake_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_verifier_core
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_verifier_core
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          # 3. stwo_cairo_air (poseidon = small, qm31 = xlarge)
          - feature: poseidon252_verifier
            package: stwo_cairo_air
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "poseidon252_verifier,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_cairo_air
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-small-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: qm31_opcode
            package: stwo_cairo_air
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-xlarge-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,blake_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_cairo_air
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-xlarge-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_cairo_air
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-xlarge-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          # 4. stwo_cairo_verifier (poseidon252 = medium, poseidon_packing = large, qm31 = xlarge)
          - feature: poseidon252_verifier
            package: stwo_cairo_verifier
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-medium-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "poseidon252_verifier,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_cairo_verifier
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-large-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: qm31_opcode
            package: stwo_cairo_verifier
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-xlarge-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,blake_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_cairo_verifier
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-xlarge-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
          - feature: "qm31_opcode,poseidon_outputs_packing"
            package: stwo_cairo_verifier
            runner: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-xlarge-ubuntu-24-04-amd64

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: software-mansion/setup-scarb@v1
      - name: Cache Scarb dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/scarb
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-scarb-${{ hashFiles('stwo_cairo_verifier/Scarb.lock') }}
      - run: scarb test --features=${{ matrix.feature }} --package ${{ matrix.package }}
      - if: matrix.package == 'stwo_cairo_verifier'
        run: scarb --profile proving execute --package stwo_cairo_verifier --features ${{ matrix.feature }} --print-resource-usage --output none --arguments-file ${{ matrix.proof_file }}

  scarb-test-circuit:
    runs-on: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-medium-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./stwo_cairo_verifier
    strategy:
      matrix:
        feature: [poseidon252_verifier, qm31_opcode]
        package:
          - stwo_circuit_air
          - stwo_circuit_verifier
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: software-mansion/setup-scarb@v1
      - name: Cache Scarb dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/scarb
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-scarb-${{ hashFiles('stwo_cairo_verifier/Scarb.lock') }}
      - run: scarb test --features=${{ matrix.feature }} --package ${{ matrix.package }}
      - if: matrix.package == 'stwo_circuit_verifier' && matrix.feature == 'qm31_opcode'
        run: scarb --profile proving execute --package stwo_circuit_verifier --features ${{ matrix.feature }} --print-resource-usage --output none --arguments-file crates/circuit_air/test_data/proof.json

  run-tests:
    runs-on: namespace-profile-starkware-libs-stwo-cairo-xlarge-ubuntu-24-04-amd64
    env:
      NEXTTEST_THREADS: "1"
      RUST_MIN_STACK: 4194304
      RUSTFLAGS: -C target-cpu=native
      RUST_LOG_SPAN_EVENTS: enter,close
      RUST_LOG: info
      RUST_BACKTRACE: full
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential
      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      - uses: software-mansion/setup-scarb@v1
      - name: Install latest nextest release
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@nextest
      - name: Fetch cache
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: cargo nextest run --cargo-profile witness-opt-1 --features=slow-tests,integration -j ${{ env.NEXTTEST_THREADS }} -P ci
      - run: cargo nextest run --cargo-profile witness-opt-1 --features=extract-mem-trace test_serialize_deserialize_mem_trace -j ${{ env.NEXTTEST_THREADS }} -P ci

  cairo-prover-wasm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - id: rust-toolchain
        run: echo "channel=$(sed -n 's/^channel = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust-toolchain.outputs.channel }}
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          components: rust-src
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build stwo_cairo_prover for wasm64
        run: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo check --target wasm64-unknown-unknown -Z build-std=std,panic_abort --package stwo-cairo-prover --release 

  cairo-air-wasm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - id: rust-toolchain
        run: echo "channel=$(sed -n 's/^channel = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust-toolchain.outputs.channel }}
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build cairo-air for wasm32
        run: cargo check --package cairo-air --no-default-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release

  crates-stable:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ env.STABLE_VERSION }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Check workspace crates (except prover and dev-utils) compile on stable
        env:
          RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: ${{ env.STABLE_VERSION }}
        run: cargo check --workspace --exclude stwo-cairo-prover --exclude stwo-cairo-dev-utils

  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - id: rust-toolchain
        run: echo "channel=$(sed -n 's/^channel = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          components: rustfmt
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust-toolchain.outputs.channel }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: scripts/rust_fmt.sh --check

  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - id: rust-toolchain
        run: echo "channel=$(sed -n 's/^channel = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          components: clippy
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust-toolchain.outputs.channel }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: scripts/clippy.sh

  cargo-lock:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - id: rust-toolchain
        run: echo "channel=$(sed -n 's/^channel = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust-toolchain.outputs.channel }}
      - name: Check Cargo.lock is up-to-date
        run: cargo fetch --locked

  typos:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: crate-ci/typos@v1.30.1

  merge-gatekeeper:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Restrict permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN.
    # Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/assigning-permissions-to-jobs
    permissions:
      checks: read
      statuses: read
    steps:
      - name: Run Merge Gatekeeper on pull request
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: upsidr/merge-gatekeeper@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          timeout: 2500
          interval: 30
          ignored: "code-review/reviewable"

      - name: Run Merge Gatekeeper on Merge Queue || push
        if: github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: upsidr/merge-gatekeeper@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{github.ref}}
          timeout: 2500
          interval: 30
          ignored: "code-review/reviewable"",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs four Scarb jobs (scarb-fmt, scarb-lint, scarb-test, scarb-test-circuit) that repeatedly resolve and download Cairo dependencies on every run, with no dependency cache. The Rust jobs already use Swatinem/rust-cache@v2, but the Scarb jobs have no equivalent. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) is supported by measured experiments showing 20.4% and 6.1% elapsed-time savings when adding actions/cache@v4 for dependency directories keyed on lockfiles. Adding a Scarb dependency cache at ~/.cache/scarb, keyed on runner OS and the hash of stwo_cairo_verifier/Scarb.lock, preserves all existing build and test steps while avoiding repeated dependency fetches. No permissions are weakened, no new secrets or network access are added, and no publishing/deployment operations are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

13. merge-gatekeeper - merge gatekeeper

The evidence includes several patterns:
- P-LIT-GHA-CACHE: Cache dependency downloads - measured benefit 20.4% in one experiment, 6.06% in another
- P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: Bound jobs with custom timeout
- P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE: Share cached build dependencies
